Surrender.Name: Surrender
Surrender.Info: Surrender to the guards nearby: hands up, and the guard arrests you once he comes. Moving away or readying a weapon before he arrives is a fake surrender.

EscortToggle.Name: AI Control (Escort / Cell)
EscortToggle.Info: Escorted: switch between walking on your own beside the guard and being led by him (led until you press it again). In your cell: switch between your own control and following the prison routine, wandering your cell like the other prisoners.

FreezeGuard.Name: [Dev] Freeze/Release Test Guard
FreezeGuard.Info: Development only: freezes the freezable test guard under the crosshair or the nearest one (test 161 spawns one); again: releases him.

FreezePrisoner.Name: [Dev] Freeze/Release Test Prisoner
FreezePrisoner.Info: Development only: freezes the freezable NPC under the crosshair or the nearest one, once he's arrested or a prisoner (test 180 imprisons one, test 181 spawns one to arrest yourself); again: releases him.
